name: Crystal Clarity

start.dialog: Sumo need inner peace! Crystals help! Need to meditate in crystal chamber! But scary alone! You guard? Keep bad things away? Sumo find enlightenment!
start.objective: Guard Sumo White during meditation in the crystal chamber

progress.dialog: *deep breathing* Sumo... becoming one... with crystals... *ominous rumbling* ...bad things coming?
progress.objective: Defend against creatures drawn to the meditation energy

complete.dialog: ENLIGHTENMENT! Sumo understand! Strength comes from WITHIN! And from good meals! Here - Crystal Focus Band! Makes you STRONG and WISE! Like Sumo!

party_comments.kade: He sat still for an hour. That takes real discipline.
party_comments.twist: He started glowing! Did you see?!
party_comments.suresh: Meditation brings clarity. Even for sumo.

hidden_outcome: If no enemies touch Sumo during the entire meditation, he achieves 'Super Enlightenment' and teaches 'Diamond Body' - ultimate defensive stance
